FAQ

Answers to all your questions about growing your team with Servi.

What solutions does Servi provide?

Servi sets a new standard in service by relieving repetitive tasks like food running, drink delivering and table bussing. In doing so, your servers are able to set their focus on what really matters – exceptional service and elevated customer experiences.

What Servi models are available?

We offer solutions for any size business!

Learn more about Servi
Learn more about Servi Plus
Learn more about Servi Q

*Servi Q is available directly from Bear Robotics in the United States and South Korea. In Japan and other select countries, Servi Q is available through our partner, SoftBank Robotics.

Where is Servi currently operating?

Servi offers automation solutions on a global scale. With presence across the US, Canada, Korea, Japan, Europe, and Singapore, Servi plays a huge role in the international hospitality community by automating repetitive tasks and enhancing service across:

Restaurants

Senior Living Communities

Casinos

Stadiums

Ghost Kitchens

Hotels

And more!

How much does Servi cost?

Costs can vary depending on certain conditions. For the best possible rate, we’ll work with you to design a custom deployment plan tailored to your business.

Drop us a line and a Bear Robotics team member will respond shortly.

Do you offer both rental subscription and purchase?

Bear Robotics is all about automation with options. Whether you’re looking for a great rental rate or would rather own a product outright, we’ve got plans for any type of purchase.

Please contact us and a Bear Robotics team member will respond shortly.

What services are included in the rental agreement?

To set our customers up for success, we offer a ton of services to get you started. These include:

Installation and mapping service

Workflow consultation

On/off site technical support

Latest software updates

Daily email reporting

Limited warranty (may vary by contract terms)

*Rental agreement may vary by country

Can I demo Servi before signing the contract?

We get that sometimes you have to take a test drive to take the leap. This is why we offer trial periods for just a small installation fee.

Do you offer a warranty?

Absolutely. We offer a variety of warranty terms to cover our comprehensive set of subscription and purchase types.

Please contact us for more information and we’ll be happy to help you discover your options.

Will Bear Robotics provide training to use Servi?

Of course. Our field operations team will be onsite for installation and training to ensure you are set up for success.

How long does installation take?

The installation process depends on the size of the space and how many robots you’re deploying. Usually just a couple of hours, though the Bear Robotics Field Engineers team will stick with you, spending several serving periods to make sure the workflow process is stable and your servers are 100% satisfied.

Do I need an internet connection to operate Servi?

To provide mapping, analytics, and instant feedback, Servi requires a high-speed internet connection. Not to worry – our field ops team will evaluate network quality during deployment and provide a standalone network if needed.

What is the maximum payload per each tray?

Visit our product pages for complete specifications:

Servi

Servi Plus

Servi Q

*Servi Q is available directly from Bear Robotics in the United States and South Korea. In Japan and other select countries, Servi Q is available through our partner, SoftBank Robotics.

What is the battery life?

Servi's average battery life is between 8 and 12 hours, and takes 4 -5 hours to fully recharge. Servi is also capable of quick charging for 1-2 hours during downtime for another 4-6 hours of operation!

*Actual operation duration of Servi will depend on usage.

Is Servi water-resistant?

Yes, Servi and Servi Plus are spill-proof and water-resistant – it’s actually the only robot of its kind with certification from the NSF for sanitation because of this.

Is Servi NSF certified?

Servi and Servi Plus are certified by the NSF for local health and compliance codes.

Can Servi be used outdoors?

Unfortunately, Servi is not currently operable outdoors. When we make updates for outdoor service, we will let you know!

Got a question we didn’t cover?

Reach out to us today, we’d love to hear from you!
